releaseNotes:
Feature: Agent API — a local, key-protected API (127.0.0.1) so an AI agent can use GitDeploy like the Telegram bot: list projects, see changes, deploy, upload files and run SSH commands
Feature: Agent API security — per-key scopes and project allow-list, human approval popup for deploy/upload/terminal, audit log, MCP endpoint for Claude Code, OpenAPI spec and docs
Feature: Settings → Agent API tab with key creation/revoke and a one-click 'Copy agent prompt' that includes the current port
Feature: Temporary mapping can hold several named targets (site1, site2 …); at upload time you tick one, several or all, and the same files go to each in turn
Feature: Deploy with a multi-target temporary mapping asks which single target to use
